trainingPlan.name: 27-Week Erlanger OD Tri Plan (Ben Reszel Method) — Start 2026-01-12
trainingPlan.description: Periodized 28-week plan (covering your full date range) balancing swim-bike-run with a bike focus, integrated technique, sustainable intensity, and regular recovery. Intervals on Tuesdays (track), swim technique Thursdays, key bike work Friday/Saturday with frequent bricks, and long run Sundays. Strength is embedded cleverly as short, repeatable add-ons. Optional tennis on Mon/Wed is noted in the workouts’ guidance.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — Intro Strides & Technique
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy jog in Zone 1, then 6min mobility (ankles/hips) + 4x80m relaxed strides (walk-back). Main: 6x400m at Zone 3 (steady/controlled, ~10K effort) with 200m easy jog recoveries. Keep form tall, quick cadence. Cooldown: 10min easy jog Zone 1. Notes: Keep it comfortable—first week back. Post-run: 10min simple strength (squats, lunges, calf raises, plank). If you play tennis tomorrow, keep today strictly controlled.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Balance, Catch & Kick
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy swim + 4x50m drill/swim (25 drill/25 swim) on 20s rest. Main: 6x100m (50m catch-up + 50m swim focusing on early vertical forearm) on 25s rest; 4x50m kick with board, 15s rest; 6x50m build 1–3, easy 4–6, 20s rest. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Focus long exhale in water, streamline off each wall. Club technique night—ask for a quick stroke check. Optional: 5min sculling between sets.

workouts.title: Bike Aerobic Cadence — Easy Spin
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy Zone 1-2. Main: 3x8min Zone 2 at 90–95rpm with 4min easy spin between; finish with 10min steady Zone 2. Cooldown: 10min easy spin. Notes: Keep upper body quiet; light pressure on pedals. Include 10min core (dead bug, side plank) after ride. Keep this mellow if you played tennis this week.

workouts.title: Long Ride — Easy Aerobic Base
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy spin Zone 1-2. Main: 60min continuous Zone 2, smooth cadence 85–95rpm. Optional: last 10min include 3x1min high-cadence (100+rpm) with 2min easy between. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Fuel every 20–25min (carb drink + small snack). If club swim at noon fits, you may swap or add short 20–30min pull-only easy later in the day (keep weekly count to 5 by dropping Fri when needed).

workouts.title: Long Run — Comfortable Aerobic
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy Zone 1. Main: 45min Zone 2 comfortable, conversational pace. Cooldown: 5min easy walk/jog + light calf/hip stretch. Notes: Focus tall posture and midfoot landing. If tennis tomorrow, keep today easy. Add 8–10min simple strength (glute bridges, band walks).

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 1K Cruise Repeats
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy Zone 1-2 + drills (A-skips, B-skips) + 4x80m strides. Main: 4x1000m at upper Zone 3 (steady/comfortably hard, half-marathon effort) with 2min easy jog recoveries. Aim even pacing. Cooldown: 10min easy jog. Notes: Cadence >170spm. Post-run: 12min S&C (split squats, single-leg RDLs, planks).

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Rotation & Timing
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m (fist drill 25m / swim 25m) 20s rest. Main: 8x100m as (75m pull buoy, 25m swim) focusing hip-driven rotation, 20–25s rest; 6x50m kick on side, 15s rest. Cooldown: 200m easy back/free. Notes: Count strokes/length; seek symmetry. If available, ask coach for quick video clip. Thursday is technique night—prioritize quality over speed.

workouts.title: Bike Tempo Intro — Sweet Spot Touches
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy Zone 1-2 with 3x30s fast legs. Main: 2x10min at high Zone 3 (sweet spot, ~90% FTP) with 5min easy between; keep cadence 85–95rpm. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Smooth power, no spikes. Add 10min mobility (hips/hamstrings).

workouts.title: Endurance Ride — Steady Z2
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy. Main: 75min Zone 2 steady, practice aero position in short bouts (3–5min) if comfortable. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Fuel consistently. Optional Sat noon club swim (easy pull 1000–1500m) only if you drop Fri or shorten today—keep total sessions to 5.

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic with Short Pickups
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 50min Zone 2, include 6x20s relaxed pickups (not sprints) every ~8min, easy jog between. Cooldown: 5–10min easy + stretch. Notes: Focus on relaxed upper body, steady breathing. If tennis Monday, hydrate well today.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 400/600 Mix
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 2 sets of (400m @ Z4 ~10K pace, 200m jog; 600m @ Z3+ controlled, 300m jog); 3min easy between sets. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep first rep conservative, aim slight negative split. Post-run: 12min S&C (lunge matrix, core).

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Pull & Bodyline
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m build 1–4, 20s rest. Main: 5x200m pull buoy @ Zone 2 focusing straight path and EVF, 25–30s rest; 6x50m kick (25 streamline/25 board) on 20s rest. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Count strokes/length on last 200—aim efficiency.

workouts.title: Bike Tempo — 3x8min
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min Z1-2 with 3x45s fast legs. Main: 3x8min high Z3 (88–92% FTP) with 4min easy between. Cadence 85–95rpm. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Stay aero for 2–3min segments if comfortable. Add 10min mobility after.

workouts.title: Endurance Ride — Cadence Variations
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy. Main: 80min Zone 2 steady with 6x2min at 100+rpm sprinkled in (2min easy between). Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Nutrition every 20–25min. Optional quick 10min transition jog Zone 1 if feeling fresh (brick-lite).

workouts.title: Long Run — Steady Z2
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 55min Zone 2 steady, focus on relaxed shoulders and cadence ~170–180spm. Cooldown: 5–10min easy + stretch. Notes: Gentle hills ok. Post-run: 10min strength add-on (glute bridge hold, calf raises, side planks).

workouts.title: Recovery Track — Technique & Short Reps
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + drills + 4x60m strides. Main: 8x300m at upper Zone 2/low Zone 3 (smooth) with 200m easy jog recoveries. Keep it relaxed and rhythmic. Cooldown: 10min easy jog. Notes: This is a deload week—err on easy. Add 8min mobility.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Streamline & Turns
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m (streamline push-offs emphasis) 20s rest. Main: 10x100m @ Zone 2 focusing on clean turns and straight exits, 15–20s rest. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Count strokes on reps 5–10, aim consistency.

workouts.title: Bike Easy Spin — High Cadence
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 5x5min Zone 2 @ 95–100rpm with 3min easy between. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep power smooth. Optional: Skip if playing tennis and feeling tired, to preserve 5 total sessions/week.

workouts.title: Endurance Ride — Easy
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 60min Zone 2 relaxed. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep this truly easy; spin out any fatigue. Light fueling only as needed.

workouts.title: Long Run — Easy & Short Drills
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 45min Zone 2 relaxed. Cooldown: 5min easy + 4x20s strides on grass. Notes: Keep it comfortable; stretch calves/hips after. If tennis Monday, hydrate well.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 5x1K Progression
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 5x1000m starting Z3 and finishing Z3+/Z4 by last rep; 2min easy jog recoveries. Aim slight negative splits. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Form over pace; keep cadence snappy. Post-run: 12min S&C (lunges, step-ups, plank).

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Paddles Intro (Light)
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m build, 20s rest. Main: 4x200m pull (buoy + SMALL paddles) @ Zone 2, 25s rest; 4x50m scull/swim 25/25; 4x50m fast-kick/ez. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Emphasize catch quality—no shoulder strain.

workouts.title: Bike Threshold Intro — 2x12min @ FTP
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy with 3x30s fast legs. Main: 2x12min at FTP (Zone 4) with 6min easy between. Focus steady power and breathing. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Stay controlled; this anchors the bike focus block. 10min mobility after.

workouts.title: Endurance Ride — Aerobic Build
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy. Main: 90min Zone 2 steady with 3x5min @ high Z3 (sweet spot) spaced evenly, 5min easy between. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Practice fueling: 60–90g carbs/hr. Aero in short chunks.

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic + Steady Finish
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 50min Zone 2 then 10min upper Zone 2 / low Zone 3. Cooldown: 5–10min easy. Notes: Smooth progression, don’t force pace. Optional 8–10min strength add-on.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 8x600m
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 8x600m @ Z3+ (10K–HM effort) with 300m easy jog between. Maintain even splits. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Tall posture, fast but relaxed arms.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Head Position & Sight
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m sighting drill (sight every 6–8 strokes), 20s rest. Main: 8x100m @ Zone 2 focusing neutral head and clean entry, 15–20s rest; 6x50m kick strong, 20s rest. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Begin light open water prep with sighting in pool.

workouts.title: Bike Threshold — 3x10min @ FTP
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy with 3x1min fast legs (1min easy). Main: 3x10min at FTP (Zone 4) with 5min easy between. Hold aero if stable. Cooldown: 10min easy spin. Notes: Smooth power output; avoid surges.

workouts.title: Endurance Ride — Z2 Steady + Short Brick
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy. Main: 95min Zone 2 steady. Cooldown: 5min easy. Transition: quick change (3–5min). Brick Run: 10–12min Zone 2 relaxed. Notes: First brick feel—keep run very easy. Practice one gel and hydration on bike.

workouts.title: Long Run — Progression
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 40min Zone 2 + 15min Zone 3 (controlled tempo). Cooldown: 10min easy jog. Notes: Practice fueling: gel at 35–40min.

workouts.title: Recovery Track — Short Repeats
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + 4x60m strides. Main: 10x300m @ Zone 3 with 200m easy jog; keep it smooth and sub-threshold. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Deload week. Add 10min mobility (hips/ankles).

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Core-Line & Kicking
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 6x150m @ Zone 2 with focus on core tension and straight line, 20s rest; 6x50m strong kick (board/streamline alt.), 20s rest. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Thursday technique night—ask for feedback on body line.

workouts.title: Bike Endurance — Easy Spin
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 60min Zone 2 steady. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep this truly easy; save legs for weekend.

workouts.title: Endurance Ride — Low Stress
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 70min Zone 2 relaxed. Cooldown: 10min. Notes: Optional short 8–10min transition jog only if fresh. Nutrition light.

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 50min Zone 2 steady. Cooldown: 5–10min easy + stretch. Notes: Keep relaxed. Optional: skip strides if playing tennis Monday.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 6x1K Threshold
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 6x1000m @ Zone 4 (threshold) with 2min easy jog. Aim consistent pace. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Focus relaxed arms and quick cadence. Post: 12min S&C.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Tempo Skills
workouts.description: Warmup: 400m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 3x300m @ Zone 2-3 focusing steady rhythm, 25s rest; 8x50m (25 fast/25 easy) on 20s rest. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Count strokes/length on the 300s.

workouts.title: Bike Threshold — 3x12min @ FTP
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + 3x45s fast legs. Main: 3x12min @ FTP (Zone 4) with 5min easy. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Hold aero as tolerated; smooth output.

workouts.title: Brick — Z2 Ride + Short Transition Run
workouts.description: Bike Warmup: 15min easy. Bike Main: 100min Zone 2 steady with 4x5min high Z3 (sweet spot) evenly spaced, 5min easy between. Bike Cooldown: 5min easy. Transition: 3–4min quick change. Run: 15min Zone 2 relaxed off the bike. Notes: Practice fueling: 70–90g carbs/hr on bike; test race drink.

workouts.title: Long Run — Steady + Tempo Finish
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 50min Zone 2 + 15min Zone 3 (HM pace feel). Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Gel at 40–45min. Keep form tall as you fatigue.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 12x400m
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 12x400m @ Zone 4 (10K pace) with 200m jog recoveries. Aim consistent pacing. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep shoulders relaxed; quick feet.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Paddles & Pull
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 5x200m pull (small paddles) @ Z2-3, 20–25s rest; 8x50m (25 fast/25 easy). Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Emphasize high-elbow catch, no over-pressing on paddles.

workouts.title: Bike Threshold — 4x10min @ FTP
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy. Main: 4x10min @ FTP with 5min easy between. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Strong but controlled; breathe rhythmically.

workouts.title: Endurance Ride — Z2 Steady
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy. Main: 110min Zone 2 steady. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Practice aero in 5–8min bouts. Fuel 70–90g carbs/hr.

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic (Rolling Terrain ok)
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 70min Zone 2 steady. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep hills aerobic. Add 10min strength (single-leg focus).

workouts.title: Recovery Track — Cruise 200s/300s
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + 4x60m strides. Main: 8x300m @ Z3 smooth with 200m jog; then 6x200m relaxed @ Z3 with 200m jog. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep all reps controlled. Deload week.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Skills Mix
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m (fist/normal) 20s. Main: 12x100m @ Z2 with technique cue each 100 (EVF, hip roll, relaxed recovery), 15–20s rest. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Smooth pacing.

workouts.title: Bike Endurance — Light
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 65min Zone 2. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Very relaxed—recover for weekend.

workouts.title: Brick — Z2 Ride + Short Transition Run
workouts.description: Bike Warmup: 15min easy. Bike Main: 85min Zone 2 steady. Bike Cooldown: 5min easy. Transition: 3–4min quick change. Run: 12–15min Zone 2 relaxed. Notes: Practice cadence upshift into transition; test shoes/socks.

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic with Strides
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 60min Zone 2. Cooldown: 5min easy + 6x20s strides. Notes: Gentle volume this week.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 5x1200m
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 5x1200m @ upper Z3/low Z4 (threshold feel) with 2:30 easy jog recoveries. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Even pacing; last rep controlled, not all-out.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Pace Skills
workouts.description: Warmup: 400m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 8x100m @ Z3 on moderate send-off (hold pace within ±2s) + 4x50m fast (15–20s rest). Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Pacing discipline; count strokes.

workouts.title: Bike Threshold — 3x12min @ FTP (Aero Focus)
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + 3x1min fast legs. Main: 3x12min @ FTP (Z4) with 5min easy; include 4–6min continuous aero each rep. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Steady power, no fade.

workouts.title: Endurance Ride — Long Z2

workouts.title: Long Run — Steady Build
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 65min Zone 2 + final 10min Zone 3. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Gel at 40–45min; check shoe comfort.

workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 3 rounds: (100m scull/swim 25/75, 100m pull @ Z2, 50m kick strong) with 20s between. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Emphasize EVF and relaxed recovery.

workouts.title: Bike Endurance — Easy Spin
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 70min Zone 2. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep fresh for weekend.

workouts.title: Brick — Z2 Ride + Short Transition Run

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic Steady

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 3x2K Threshold
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 3x2000m @ Z4 (threshold) with 3min easy jog. Keep splits even. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Strong aerobic stimulus; no sprinting.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Strong Pull
workouts.description: Warmup: 400m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 4x300m pull (buoy+small paddles) @ Z3, 25s rest; 6x50m (25 fast/25 easy) 20s rest. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Maintain catch quality under load.

workouts.title: Bike Threshold — 3x12min @ FTP (Aero Focus)
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + 3x1min fast legs. Main: 3x12min FTP (Z4) with 5min easy; ride 6–8min aero each rep. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Steady, no spikes.

workouts.title: Endurance Ride — Long Z2 (Hilly Optional)
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy. Main: 130min Zone 2 steady; hills are fine but stay aerobic. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Fuel 80–90g carbs/hr; practice bottle swaps if possible.

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic + Strides
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 75min Zone 2 steady. Cooldown: 5–10min easy + 6x20s strides. Notes: Soft surface preferred.

workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + 4x60m strides. Main: 5x1000m @ Z3 (sub-threshold) with 2min jog. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Deload week; keep HR capped.

workouts.title: Bike Endurance — Easy Spin
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 60min Zone 2 steady. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep relaxed cadence 90–95rpm.

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 60min Zone 2. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep it comfortable. Gentle mobility afterward.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 6x1K (Sharpen)
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 6x1000m @ Z4 (threshold) with 2min jog. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Strong but sustainable.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Paddles & Pace Control
workouts.description: Warmup: 400m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 3x300m pull @ Z3 (25s rest), hold split; 8x50m (25 fast/25 easy). Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Keep shoulder-friendly paddles only.

workouts.title: Bike Threshold — 4x10min (Aero)
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy. Main: 4x10min @ FTP (Z4) with 5min easy. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Smooth power; aero segments 6–8min each rep.

workouts.title: Endurance Ride — Long Z2
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy. Main: 140min Zone 2 steady. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Fuel 90g carbs/hr. Practice mental focus in aero.

workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 65min Zone 2. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep cadence light and legs fresh.

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 60min Zone 2 steady. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep terrain simple.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 4x1600m
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 4x1600m @ Z4 (threshold) with 3min easy jog. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Practice even splits; strong aerobic focus.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — OW Skills in Pool
workouts.description: Warmup: 400m easy + 4x50m sighting drill. Main: 6x150m @ Z3 with sighting every 6–8 strokes, 20s rest; 4x50m fast on 20s. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Practice drafting with lane-mates if possible.

workouts.title: Bike Threshold — 4x12min @ FTP
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + 3x1min fast legs. Main: 4x12min @ FTP (Z4) with 5min easy. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Bike focus continues—smooth power, aero tolerance.

workouts.title: Endurance Ride — Long Z2 + Tempo Touches

workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + 4x60m strides. Main: 12x300m @ Z3 with 200m jog, relaxed. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Recovery week—keep it easy.

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 55min Zone 2 steady. Cooldown: 5–10min easy. Notes: Optional strides only if fresh.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 8x800m (Sharpen)
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 8x800m @ Z4 (10K effort) with 2min jog. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Efficient pacing.

workouts.title: Swim — OW Skills (If Possible Outdoors)
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m sighting. Main: 6x200m @ Z3 continuous with sighting every 6–8 strokes; practice drafting with partner if possible. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: If pool only, simulate with buoy line; practice turns as buoy rounding.

workouts.title: Bike Threshold — 3x12min @ FTP + 4x2min VO2
workouts.description: Warmup: 20min easy with 3x45s fast legs. Main: 3x12min @ FTP (Z4) with 5min easy; then 4x2min @ Z5 (110–120% FTP) with 3min easy. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: First VO2 touches—keep quality high.

workouts.title: Race Rehearsal Brick — Bike Z3 Blocks + Run Z3

Run: 25min starting Z2 for 10min then Z3 (goal OD run pace feel) for 15min. Notes: Full nutrition test (bike: 80–90g carbs/hr).

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic with Tempo Insert
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 50min Z2 + 20min Z3. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Gel at 40–45min; take water. Assess shoe choice for race.

workouts.title: Recovery Track — 12x300m
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + 4x60m strides. Main: 12x300m @ Z3 with 200m jog. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Recovery week volume drop.

workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 10x100m @ Z2 technique cues, 15–20s rest; 6x50m kick. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Prioritize economy.

workouts.title: Bike Endurance — Easy
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 60min Z2 steady. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep fresh for weekend.

workouts.title: Brick — Z2 Ride + 25min Run
workouts.description: Bike Warmup: 15min easy. Bike Main: 85min Zone 2. Bike Cooldown: 5min. Transition: 3–4min. Run: 25min Zone 2-3 progressive. Notes: Keep total load moderate—recovery week.

workouts.title: Long Run — Easy
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 55min Zone 2. Cooldown: 5–10min easy. Notes: Optional strides only if fresh.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 10x400m (Sharpen)
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 10x400m @ Z4 (10K pace) with 200m jog. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep consistent splits; relaxed form.

workouts.title: Swim — Pace/OW Skills
workouts.description: Warmup: 400m easy + 4x50m sighting. Main: 4x300m @ Z3 (steady pace control) with sighting 6–8 strokes; 6x50m fast on 20s. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Try group starts (3–5 side-by-side) if safe.

workouts.title: Bike Threshold — 3x12min @ FTP + 6x1min @ Z5
workouts.description: Warmup: 20min easy + 3x45s legs. Main: 3x12min @ FTP with 5min easy; then 6x1min @ Z5 (120% FTP) with 2min easy. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Quality first; keep last intervals crisp, not sloppy.

workouts.title: Race Simulation Brick — Bike Z3 Blocks + Run Z3
workouts.description: Bike Warmup: 15min easy. Bike Main: 2x30min @ high Z3 (88–92% FTP) with 10min easy between. Bike Cooldown: 5min. Transition: 3–4min. Run: 30min with 10min Z2 then 20min Z3 (goal OD pace feel). Notes: Full race nutrition test; practice transitions and setup.

workouts.title: Long Run — Steady
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 70min Zone 2 steady. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep it aerobic after big brick.

workouts.title: Recovery Track — Cruise 1Ks
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + 4x60m strides. Main: 5x1000m @ Z3 with 2min jog. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Recovery week; limit intensity.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Efficiency
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 10x100m @ Z2 technique focus, 15–20s rest; 6x50m kick. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Emphasize easy speed; low effort.

workouts.title: Bike Endurance — Easy Spin
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 60min Z2. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep fresh.

workouts.title: Brick — Z2 Ride + 25min Run
workouts.description: Bike Warmup: 15min easy. Bike Main: 80min Zone 2 steady. Bike Cooldown: 5min. Transition: 3–4min. Run: 25min Zone 2 easy. Notes: Maintain light load in recovery week.

workouts.title: Long Run — Easy
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 50min Zone 2. Cooldown: 5–10min easy. Notes: Optional strides if fresh.

workouts.title: Track Intervals — 3x2K (Race-Adj.)
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 3x2000m @ Z4 (threshold) with 3min jog; last 400m of each slightly faster (Z4+). Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Practice control—finish strong not all-out.

workouts.title: Swim — Pace + Starts
workouts.description: Warmup: 400m easy + 4x50m fast starts/settle. Main: 3x300m @ Z3 with 50m strong start then settle to pace; 6x50m fast on 20s. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Practice sighting; simulate mass start if possible.

workouts.title: Bike Over-Unders — 4x10min
workouts.description: Warmup: 20min easy + 3x45s fast legs. Main: 4x10min alternating 2min @ 95% FTP (Z3/4) and 1min @ 105% FTP (Z4/5) with 6min easy between. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Race-specific strength; stay smooth in aero.

workouts.title: Race Rehearsal Brick — OD Pacing
workouts.description: Bike Warmup: 15min easy. Bike Main: 60min @ high Z3 (88–92% FTP) continuous, practice race cadence; include 2x4min @ FTP mid-ride. Bike Cooldown: 5min. Transition: 3–4min. Run: 35min starting 10min Z2 then 25min Z3 (goal OD run pace). Notes: Full kit, full fueling, practice transition layout.

workouts.title: Long Run — Aerobic (Shorter)
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 55min Zone 2. Cooldown: 5–10min easy. Notes: Keep aerobic to absorb Saturday.

workouts.title: Recovery Track — 8x400m
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + 4x60m strides. Main: 8x400m @ Z3 with 200m jog, smooth. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Recovery week before final sharpen.

workouts.title: Swim Technique — Economy
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 10x100m @ Z2 technique, 15–20s rest; 4x50m fast. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Prioritize streamline and catch feel.

workouts.title: Bike Endurance — Easy Spin
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 60min Z2. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep legs snappy, not tired.

workouts.title: Brick — Z2 Ride + 20min Run (Light)
workouts.description: Bike Warmup: 15min easy. Bike Main: 75min Zone 2. Bike Cooldown: 5min. Transition: 3–4min. Run: 20min Zone 2 easy. Notes: Light brick to maintain feel.

workouts.title: Long Run — Easy
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 50min Zone 2. Cooldown: 5–10min easy. Notes: Relaxed; begin mental rehearsal for race.

workouts.title: Track — 5x1K @ Threshold (Last Big Run Quality)
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + drills + 4x80m strides. Main: 5x1000m @ Z4 with 2min jog, keep smooth and controlled. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Strong but not maximal.

workouts.title: Swim — Pace Maintenance + Fast 50s
workouts.description: Warmup: 400m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 6x150m @ Z3 steady on moderate send-off; 6x50m fast on 20s. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Keep feel for water; do not overload shoulders.

workouts.title: Bike — Over-Unders 3x10min (Last Big Bike Quality)
workouts.description: Warmup: 20min easy + 3x45s fast legs. Main: 3x10min alternating 2min @ 95% FTP and 1min @ 105% FTP with 6min easy between. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Crisp, not exhaustive.

workouts.title: Brick — 60min Z2 Ride + 15min Z2 Run
workouts.description: Bike Warmup: 10min easy. Bike Main: 45min Z2 steady. Bike Cooldown: 5min. Transition: 3–4min. Run: 15min Z2 easy. Notes: Short and sweet—feel only.

workouts.title: Run — Easy Aerobic
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 40min Z2. Cooldown: 5–10min easy. Notes: Begin taper—reduce volume, keep legs fresh. Optional gentle strides (4x15s).

workouts.title: Taper Track — 8x400m @ 10K Pace
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + drills + 4x60m strides. Main: 8x400m @ Z4 (10K pace) with 200m jog; keep it snappy, not draining. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Sharpening; stop if form fades.

workouts.title: Swim — Race-Pace Touches
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 8x100m @ Z4 (race-pace feel) on generous rest (20–25s); 4x50m fast starts. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Stay fresh; perfect form.

workouts.title: Bike — 3x6min @ 95–100% FTP
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + 3x30s fast legs. Main: 3x6min @ 95–100% FTP (Z3/4) with 4min easy. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Keep pop without fatigue.

workouts.title: Brick — Short Opener
workouts.description: Bike Warmup: 10min easy. Bike Main: 25min Z2 with 3x2min @ Z3 (2min easy between). Bike Cooldown: 5min. Transition: 3min. Run: 10min Z2 with 3x20s pickups. Notes: Keep it short—feel sharp.

workouts.title: Run — Easy Recovery
workouts.description: Warmup: 8min easy. Main: 30min Z1-2 easy. Cooldown: 5–7min walk + light stretch. Notes: Relax and recover; visualize race execution.

workouts.title: Taper Track — 6x400m @ 10K Pace
workouts.description: Warmup: 12min easy + 4x60m strides. Main: 6x400m @ Z4 (10K pace) with 200m jog. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Short, crisp, stop well before fatigue.

workouts.title: Swim — Race Skills & Pace
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy + 4x50m build. Main: 6x100m @ race pace (Z4) on 20–25s rest + 4x50m fast starts. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Keep shoulders fresh; perfect form.

workouts.title: Bike — 2x5min @ 95–100% FTP + Openers
workouts.description: Warmup: 15min easy + 3x20s high-cadence. Main: 2x5min @ 95–100% FTP with 4min easy; then 4x30s fast legs/90s easy. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Stay fresh; no strain.

workouts.title: Brick — Pre-Race Opener
workouts.description: Bike Warmup: 10min easy. Bike Main: 20min Z2 with 2x1min @ Z3. Bike Cooldown: 5min. Transition: 3min. Run: 8–10min Z2 with 2x20s pickups. Notes: All easy—finish fresh and confident.

workouts.title: Run — Easy Shakeout
workouts.description: Warmup: 8min easy. Main: 20–25min Z1-2. Cooldown: 5–7min walk + mobility. Notes: Relax; confirm race logistics and gear.

workouts.title: Taper Track — 4x400m @ 10K Pace
workouts.description: Warmup: 10–12min easy + 4x60m strides. Main: 4x400m @ Z4 with 200m jog. Cooldown: 10min easy. Notes: Light and crisp.

workouts.title: Swim — Easy with 4x50m Fast
workouts.description: Warmup: 300m easy. Main: 4x50m fast/long rest; 6x50m easy swim. Cooldown: 200m easy. Notes: Keep shoulders loose; visualize start & sighting.

workouts.title: Bike — Easy Spin + 3x30s Openers
workouts.description: Warmup: 10min easy. Main: 20min Z2 steady. Cooldown: 5min easy; include 3x30s high cadence with 90s easy. Notes: Legs only; finish feeling bouncy.

workouts.title: Pre-Race Shakeout — Swim/Transitions (Optional)
workouts.description: Warmup: 5–8min easy jog or 10min easy spin ONLY if you need it. Main: Optional: 10–15min easy swim with 4x20–30m pick-ups, review sighting & drafting; walk through transitions. Cooldown: 5–10min easy. Notes: Keep total sessions to 5 this week including race; if you do this, consider skipping earlier brick opener. Hydrate, prepare gear.

workouts.title: RACE — Erlanger Triathlon (OD)
workouts.description: Warmup: Short dynamic warmup + 5–8min easy swim with a few 15–20s pick-ups (if allowed). Main (Race): Swim 1500m steady start & settle (focus sighting every 6–8 strokes, draft when possible). T1: Efficient, calm. Bike 40km: Settle quickly to high Z3 (~88–92% FTP), avoid surges, fuel 60–80g carbs/hr. T2: Quick but composed. Run 10km: First 2km Z2-3 settle, then hold Z3 (goal OD pace), last 1–2km build if strong. Cooldown: Walk, rehydrate, gentle stretch. Notes: Execute pacing, nutrition, and transitions as practiced. Enjoy the day!
